mapper.select: /* 반려동물의 모든 항목 회차 조회(항목, 관찰일 순) */ SELECT T.OBSRV_CYCL_SN , T.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN , T.CYCL_NO , T.OBSRV_DT , T.OBSRV_SZ , T.OBSRV_CHG_CD , C.COM_CD_NM AS OBSRV_CHG_CD_NM , T.MEMO_CN FROM ( SELECT Y.OBSRV_CYCL_SN , Y.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Y.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN ORDER BY Y.OBSRV_DT, Y.OBSRV_CYCL_SN) AS CYCL_NO , Y.OBSRV_DT , Y.OBSRV_SZ , Y.OBSRV_CHG_CD , Y.MEMO_CN FROM OBSRV_CYCL Y JOIN OBSRV_ARTCL A ON A.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN = Y.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN WHERE A.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND Y.DEL_YN = 'N' ) T LEFT JOIN COM_CD C ON C.COM_CD = T.OBSRV_CHG_CD ORDER BY T.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN, T.CYCL_NO

/* 관찰 항목 조회(경로 반려동물 기준) */ SELECT OBSRV_ARTCL_SN , PET_SN , OBSRV_REGN_CD , OBSRV_STTS_CD , OBSRV_ARTCL_NM , OBSRV_REGN_DTL_NM , OBSRV_END_YMD , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID , DEL_YN FROM OBSRV_ARTCL WHERE OBSRV_ARTCL_SN = #{obsrvArtclSn} AND PET_SN = #{petSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 관찰 회차 조회(경로 반려동물 기준) */ SELECT Y.OBSRV_CYCL_SN , Y.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN , Y.ATCH_FILE_SN , Y.OBSRV_CHG_CD , Y.OBSRV_SZ , Y.MEMO_CN , Y.OBSRV_DT , Y.DEL_YN , Y.REG_DT , Y.MDFCN_DT , Y.RGTR_ID , Y.MDFR_ID FROM OBSRV_CYCL Y JOIN OBSRV_ARTCL A ON A.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN = Y.OBSRV_ARTCL_SN WHERE Y.OBSRV_CYCL_SN = #{obsrvCyclSn} AND A.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND Y.DEL_YN = 'N'
